text.en: If your army includes a MARNEUS CALGAR unit, you can select the assault doctrine/devastator doctrine/tactical doctrine each one additional time per battle.
CAPTAIN model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has:
2+ Sv.
Feel No Pain 5+.

ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
+1 S and AP.
Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, +2 S and AP.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].
